title: From Workspace
text: Load signal data from workspace into Simulink model, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets Loaded workspace data type Inherit:; {Data}, {Sample time} sets the output sample period and optional time, {Interpolate data} sets the interpolation method, {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the zero-crossing detection and {Form output after final data value by} sets the method to determine block output after final data point. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Data loaded from workspace scalar | vector | matrix | array

params.name: Data
params.values: Data to load from workspace timeseries object | timetable object | structure | 2-D array | MATLAB expression

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Loaded workspace data type Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 |...

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Output sample period and optional time offset 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Form output after final data value by
params.values: Method to determine block output after final data point Extrapolation (default) | Setting to zero | Holding final value | Cyclic repetition
